description: Searches the hardware catalog (article number, type identifier, version). Requires TIA connected. By default the (long) 'description' is OMITTED — on broad filters it blows up the payload (description × firmware variants); pass verbose:true WITH a specific filter to include it. Maps to GET /catalog?filter=&typeIdentifier=&verbose=. Read-only (R).

filter.description: filter text: article no., description, etc. (optional)

verbose.description: include the full 'description' (off by default; on broad filters it blows up the payload — use with a specific filter)

name: tia_catalog
title: TIA — search the hardware catalog
